description: Gumbel distribution survival function -expm1(-exp(-(x - mu) / beta)) (location mu, scale beta)

tolerance.reason: z = (x - mu) / beta is exact on this grid (see gumbel_cdf). Q = -expm1(-w) with w = exp(-z) has condition number w / (e^w - 1), at most 1, in w, so rounding w and the expm1 cost a few ulps. 1e-13 as for the other functions; results below 2.2e-308 are judged relative to that number (conventions)

grid: the gumbel_cdf grid: (mu, beta) in {(0, 1), (0, 2^-500), (0, 2^500), (-10, 1/4), (100, 8), (-2^1023, 2^1023)} x x = mu + beta z for z = -7..40 step 1/4, z in {-1000, -100, -20, -10, -8, -7.5, 50, 100, 200, 500, 700, 708, 708.5, 709, 710, 720, 740, 745, 746, 800, 1000, 1e5, 1e10, 1e100, 1e300} and z = +-2^-30, kept where x is an exact, finite double that is 0 or normal (so z = (x - mu) / beta is exact); Q rounds to 1 below about z = -3.6, is subnormal from about z = 708.4 and 0 above about z = 745.1
